# Sentences from en.txt and de.txt that the engine still acts on. Format: lang | category | sentence.
#
# This file only shrinks. tests/must_not_act.rs fails when a sentence that is not listed here
# acts, and fails when a listed sentence no longer acts. A fix deletes its lines; nobody adds
# lines for behaviour that got worse. Lines stay sorted.
